from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    email: str
    email_domain: str
    is_anchor_user: bool
    name: str
    principal_id: str
    scope: str
    client_id: str | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            email=data.get("email"),
            email_domain=data.get("emailDomain"),
            is_anchor_user=data.get("isAnchorUser"),
            name=data.get("name"),
            principal_id=data.get("principalId"),
            scope=data.get("scope"),
            client_id=data.get("clientId"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "email": self.email,
            "emailDomain": self.email_domain,
            "isAnchorUser": self.is_anchor_user,
            "name": self.name,
            "principalId": self.principal_id,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "clientId": self.client_id,
        }
